scope: Public reports published by cutoff, filed for the issuer in the frozen 90-day window. Completeness refers to source inventories and visible reports. Late or exempt unreported activity is unknowable at cutoff. Holdings, Form 144 proposals, past-sale tables and 13D/G ownership statements are not summed with Section 16 trades. No net flow or sentiment inferred.

methods.sec: Filter issuer CIK submissions and all overlapping historical file manifests by filing acceptance (UTC). Reconcile distinct accession sets with both issuer-CIK master indices. At 09:00 UTC on November 25 EDGAR had not opened for its 06:00 ET session. Inspect original XML for each accession, matching stated issuer CIK and form. Both nonderivative and derivative holdings and transactions are retained. The XML’s filing-level 10b5-1 flag applies to the document. An unchecked flag alone does not establish discretion. Numeric strings retain the disclosed precision.
methods.form144: Proposed sales and prior-three-month execution rows have different meanings. Past-sale lines may repeat across notices and overlap Section 16 or Schedule 13D execution records. They are stored separately and never added to primary transaction counts.
methods.price_currency: US Section 16 price column is reported in USD. Foreign-currency execution explicitly explained by a footnote is separately identified. CNMV quotes EUR. Derivative units, price-bucket rows and paired ownership changes are never collapsed into trade counts.
